decision: Merge-chokepoint runs of verify:orphan-active are scoped to the candidate's own diff; repo-wide residue truth stays on the delivery tip, the bare verb, and the after-merge --issue N run.

governingRule.description: Gate integrity (#3156): a gate may be scoped or strengthened deliberately under issue/PR review, but never weakened to clear a red.

alternativesConsidered.option: Keep the unscoped repo-wide predicate on check:merge -- refuted by measurement: four unrelated PRs failed on one stranded brief and N stranded briefs make N single-brief lifecycle PRs mutually unmergeable.

Relocate verify:orphan-active off the merge gate by analogy to verify:completed-tracked -- refuted by the design critique: the two checks key on different state, so relocation on that analogy would silently drop the merged-PR/open-issue class.

Process-only: make scope:complete atomic with its merge -- refuted: #2321 assigns completion after merge, so an immutable product merge cannot carry its own transition, and two stranded briefs still deadlock independent cleanups.
Whole-set recovery transaction that clears every stranded brief at once -- larger surface and still leaves an unrelated PR holding merge authority over another agent's residue.

whyWinner: Diff ownership removes merge authority over residue the candidate did not create without touching the detector: assessOrphanSignature is unchanged, so the linked-PR/open-issue signature is preserved rather than retired under #3156. The pre-merge run had no unique preventive value for its own candidate anyway, because that candidate's linked PR still reads merged_at null while the gate runs.
revisitTrigger: A stranded brief survives to a release cut undetected, or evidence appears that the pre-merge repo-wide run uniquely caught residue a delivery-tip or after-merge run would have missed.
